minor.endpoint: GET /api/admin/books/{id}/mocks/{mid}/page/{n} (and every inspect() caller via book_store.original())
minor.issue: Can return 422 'The cached original was refreshed. Retry; saved progress is kept.' The shared cache $TMP/jeelive-book-originals keeps only the 6 newest PDFs. When other books are being uploaded or processed, remember() can delete this book's cached file after cached() has returned its path but before book_pdf.run() links it. The proof view / fix tool then shows 'Page ki picture nahi khuli' and does not retry. Seen 2 times in 3 desktop proof runs while another book test ran; 0 times in 3 runs with nothing else running.

integration_issues.flow: Proof view / fix tool page picture
integration_issues.issue: CutTool.pageImage() turns one failed fetch into a permanent error card. There is no automatic retry, even though the backend's own message says 'Retry'.

action_items: Make original() / mock_page robust to the cache-eviction race. Options: retry once on 'cached original was refreshed'; pin the file (hard-link or open it) before eviction can run; never evict a file used in the last N seconds; or raise the 6-file cap.
Optionally let CutTool.pageImage retry a failed page fetch once (the cache entry is already dropped on failure, so only the error card needs a retry path).
critical_code_review_comments: book_store.remember(): eviction by mtime with [:-6] runs while other requests may hold a path returned by cached(). That is a TOCTOU race between cached() and book_pdf.run() os.link (FileNotFoundError -> ValueError -> 422). It gets more likely as more books are worked on at once.

exam-refinement.css: --piece-bleed 12px (player) and 36px (review) are hard-coded to match the current padding of the containers. If .question-card or .review-question padding changes on phones, the stem and options will overflow or stop lining up. Worth a comment, or deriving the value from a shared custom property.

rca of the issue: Proofbox-desk flake. Repro: run tests/chapters_iso182.py (it uploads and processes several PDFs) and, at the same time, run tests/ui_verify212.py proofbox desk. Q1's page request returns 422 and the card shows 'Page ki picture nahi khuli'. Root cause: tejas/book_store.py remember() deletes all but the 6 newest cached PDFs. A request whose cached() call has already returned the target path can then fail in book_pdf.run() at os.link (FileNotFoundError), which mock_page turns into 422. Mitigation: retry inside original()/run() when the file is gone, pin the file before use, or protect recently-used files from eviction; plus a one-time retry on the client.
